svg.title: JIANT FM · Navigation map · V10.7.31
svg.text: firmware V10.7.31 · six rules, one chain of pages per section

text.tspan: Ten buttons, ten sections. SELECT walks a section's pages as one chain; its button jumps group to

svg.text: a tab = a group (the button jumps to the next one, round)
the line = SELECT's order, stops at both ends
dashed = only on the engines (or LOAD) that have it

text.tspan: GEN 1–3: PRESETS the genre, OCT+ makes the piece, OCT− back to MACROS. TIMELINE ARRANGE PARTS: the song (V10.7.32, from
PRESETS: the patterns (PHRASES). KNOB 1: all 64 steps on STEP, bar after bar.

svg.text: ANALOG PHASE LOFI WHEEL VOICE ANIMAL …

text.tspan: TONE pages only where the engine has them: MORPH (ANALOG PHASE LOFI), RETRIG (LOFI), ROTOR (WHEEL), WORDS (VOICE). DRUM-X: KNOB 1 picks the kit's sound on SOUND.
CHORUS and SLICER are hidden with LOAD ECO; the chain skips them. PUNCH IN: on the FX held (the lane at the foot, FX + PRESETS its knobs).
KNOB 1: the slot on MOD, the step on MSEQ.
From outside, USER and PART SLOTS come with SAVE armed: SAVE · OCT+ · OCT+.
One chain per section, a page a detent; it stops at the
first and the last. No levels, no zoom.
From elsewhere, the page you left there. Inside, the
first page of the next group, round.
The track's sounds everywhere, patterns in SEQ, the
genre in GEN. Never a page, a track or a module.
The step, the bar, the slot, the stage, the operator, the
kit's sound. The track is always ALGORITHM's.
A button held puts its shortcuts on the keys and
knobs; ALGORITHM while held: MAP · KNOBS · STATE.
Tabs on top: the groups, a dot a page. At the foot:
the MENU: DISPLAY · CONTROL · AUDIO · SYSTEM (SELECT the rows, ALGORITHM the tabs)
F3 INIT · G3 RECALL · DRUM: black keys 1–8 mute each sound
F3 CLEAR · G3 REVERSE · A3/B3 SHIFT · F4 CLR AUTO · G4–B4 LANE CLEAR / REVERSE / FILL ·
punch-in: F3–A3 REPEAT · B3/C4 LPF/HPF · D4/E4 OCT · F4 ½ TEMPO · G4/A4 DEC · B4/C5
STUTTER · D5 ATK+ · E5 ARP · F5 RANDOM · PRESETS: the lane's knobs
black 1–6 MUTE · F3–D4 SOLO · E4 unmute all · F4 TAP ·
KNOB 1–4 = M1–M4, latched · F3 new routes · G3 clear
F3–B3 play A–D · C4–F4 store A–D ·
· D5 LOOP/SONG · E5 SONG REC · G5 ARRANGE
their dice: BEFORE / NOW, keep or
CLR STEP: the step and its locks
